about: Skills tool: Simpson's diversity index. Solver and generator: ApBioProblems, kind simpson. Built now, published with Unit 8: every item is tagged stats-simpson, whose map entry sits after the Unit 8 topic biodiversity.
intro: Measure how diverse a community is from counts of each species, using the formula-sheet version of Simpson’s diversity index.
howItWorksTitle: The formula, and how answers are checked
howItWorks:
D = 1 − Σ (n / N)²

  • n is the number of individuals of one species; N is the total number of individuals of all species.
  • D is 0 when there is only one species and gets closer to 1 as there are more species and their numbers are more even.
  • The total N must be exact. Σ(n/N)² counts when within 0.001 or 2%, and D when within 0.01 or 2%, so rounding n/N on the way is fine.
